purpose: Prevent the iOS Aracne modal from freezing after route requests and keep note/carnet actions responsive.

cases.given: A route contains a waypoint whose coordinates are null, stale, or outside the Salento safety bounds.
expect: coordinates are recovered from the canonical POI when possible
invalid waypoints are filtered before any Leaflet marker is created
the Aracne request continues instead of throwing from L.marker

cases.given: The public routing provider does not answer promptly on Safari or iOS.
expect: the primary routing request is aborted after a bounded timeout
the driving fallback is also bounded
local route geometry is used if both network attempts fail
the Aracne answer is not left waiting indefinitely

cases.given: An unexpected exception occurs while processing Chiedi ad Aracne.
expect: the ask button is always re-enabled
a visible error result is shown
a toast is displayed above the assistant modal

cases.given: The user taps Salva nota while the Aracne modal is open.
expect: the note is persisted as before
the confirmation toast renders above the modal overlay

cases.given: A previous route answer still has a delayed WebKit speech/map fallback pending.
expect: opening the carnet invalidates the old reveal token
old speech fallback callbacks cannot close the newly opened carnet
the carnet remains interactive

cases.given: A new Aracne interaction begins before a previous iOS speech fallback timer expires.
expect: the previous speech run is cancelled
fallback callbacks verify their speech run id
the old answer cannot close or replace the new interaction

cases.given: The transcript is: Parlami di Lecce e che cosa si può fare cosa c'è da vedere cosa c'è intorno e costruiscimi un percorso che va da Lecce a Maglie da Maglie a Gallipoli da Gallipoli a Nardò.
expect: tapping Chiedi ad Aracne produces either a normal answer/route or an explicit recoverable error
the UI never becomes silently stuck
Salva nota and Apri il mio carnet remain usable
